messages:
josh_sales: ping — Marigold Health just flagged a regression: p95 for their chat flows jumped from ~220ms to ~950ms since yesterday's model rollout. They see it across regions (us-east/us-west). Customer is on Dedicated with reserved capacity. They want an ETA and workaround. @maria_pm assigning to you for prioritization.

maria_pm: thanks Josh. Can you paste the example request ids / sample payloads and the time window? we need to know if it's request size, model variant, or infra.

josh_sales: sample ids: req_20260319_1, req_20260319_2 — sent in DM. Happens mostly between 13:00–15:00 UTC yesterday and again this morning. They say throughput was steady but tail latency spiked. Customer is threatening to backfill to an older model if we don't fix within 48h.

patrick_support: adding context from support: Marigold observed a lot of 429s shortly before the spike, then the p95 climbed. No change on their end. They are on autoscale with burst=2x.

alexa_oncall: looking at deploys — there was a hosted catalog update and a routing policy push yesterday at 12:45 UTC that changed fallback policy for model weights (new small-quantized variant introduced). Oncall traces for the customer's dedicated pool show queueing on the inference workers from 12:50–14:30 UTC. attaching trace ids in thread.

devin_eng: queueing makes sense. Early hypothesis: new routing fallback increased cold-starts to quantized variant that hits a different serving binary causing transient kernel load and slower latencies under load. Might be batching spikes combined with slower memcpy on that binary.

olga_data: I pulled request timing and kernel metrics for Marigold's pool  — p50 unaffected, p95/p99 aligned with increased batch size and GPU compute stalls. CPU side shows higher GC-ish pauses in the serving agent around the same window.

maria_pm: ok — thanks. So recommended path: short-term mitigation to stop customer pain, medium-term plan and launch criteria for a fix. Options?

devin_eng: short-term: 1) pin Marigold's routing policy to the pre-rollout model variant (rollback routing) — manual config change. 2) temporarily increase their dedicated pool headroom (burst cap + spin additional nodes). Both are low-risk and can be done within hours. Medium-term: revert the fallback behavior in the routing service, add a relaxed rollout gating (monitor kernel load), and create an integration test for quantized-variant cold-start perf.

alexa_oncall: I can apply the routing pin for them now if product approves. Also can trigger immediate +1 burst node for 2 hours to buy time. Need confirmation from infra (cc @sre_bot).

sre_bot: infra note: we have available burst quota in the region. Auto-scaling will obey new headroom, but manual scale-up requires a ticket to infra runbook; I can do it if eng owns the follow-up.

maria_pm: go ahead with both mitigations. Devin, can you own the rollback of the routing fallback as a hotfix? Estimate: 1–2 dev-hours for patch and canary, then roll to all dedicated customers after validation.

devin_eng: I can do the hotfix. Will scope: 1) revert fallback OR add a top-level routing override flag per-customer, 2) add telemetry that breaks down latency by model-variant and cold-start. I'll open a PR and link it here.

patrick_support: I'll email Marigold with interim steps: (1) we pinned you to the previous model variant, (2) we scaled your pool by +1 for the next 2h, (3) we'll follow up with a permanent fix within 48h. Tentative message in thread: "we've applied a temporary routing pin and added headroom; monitoring now" — want PM approval.

maria_pm: send that, add apology and ETA. Set expectation: we'll follow up with a remediation plan within 48h and a postmortem assessing root cause.

olga_data: for the backlog: suggested tickets — BUG: routing fallback increases latency under certain serving-binary combos (regression); TASK: add integration perf test for quantized variant cold-starts; DOC: add rollout gating checklist. Assign severity P2 for customer SLA impact (dedicated, not widespread).

maria_pm: agreed P2. We'll scope for immediate hotfix this sprint and the integration test in next sprint. Rollout gating checklist to be a cross-functional item.

devin_eng: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/route-fallback/pull/341 — hotfix branch 'route-pin-rollback'. Running canary now for 10% of dedicated pools including Marigold.

alexa_oncall: canary results: Marigold's pool latency dropped back to ~240ms p95 within 12 minutes of applying the pin. No error uptick.

sre_bot: automated alert: Marigold p95 normalized at 14:12 UTC.

patrick_support: customer reply: "Thanks — latency is back to normal. We'll monitor and need confirmation when this is fully resolved."

maria_pm: next steps (action items):
- devin_eng: complete hotfix rollout and merge PR (ETA EOD) -> comment in PR when merged.
- devin_eng + olga_data: add telemetry breakdown by variant + perf integration test (ETA 2 sprints).
- alexa_oncall + sre_bot: run incident baseline checks and ensure autoscale runbook updated (ETA 48h).
- patrick_support: send customer confirmation and schedule 24h check-in.
- maria_pm: open product-backlog ticket with scope, launch criteria, and docs deadline.

maria_pm: I'll create the backlog ticket now and tag eng/platform and eng-runtime for prioritization. If anyone objects to P2 severity or the timeline, speak up now.

devin_eng: no objections. Will start the rollout tasks.

patrick_support: sending customer note now.

josh_sales: appreciating the fast ops here — please cc me on final customer note so I can sync with them.

maria_pm: created ticket PROD-4872: "Routing fallback regression — quantized variant cold-start increases p95 for dedicated pools". Fields: severity=P2, owner=devin_eng, milestone=hotfix-EoD, roadmap impact=requires rollout gating + test in sprint+1. Link in thread.

alexa_oncall: closing loop — routing pin applied, +1 burst node for 2h, hotfix canary passing. I'll monitor for 24h then handoff to oncall rotation.

patrick_support: customer confirmed stable after 30m. closing customer incident on our side, will leave the ticket open for the engineering follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

maria_pm: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in the backlog grooming to discuss permanent rollout gating and monitoring thresholds (we need a clear launch criteria for model variants: perf header, cold-start p95 < 350ms at 95th percentile of load, telemetry enabled)"
